# Royal Kings Premier School

> Christian-centred CBC school in Riverside, Wangige, Kiambu County, Kenya.
> Creche & Early Years, Primary (Grades 1–6), Junior School (Grades 7–9).

Official website: https://royalkingsschools.sc.ke/
Phone: +254 719 396 233
Email: info@royalkingsschools.sc.ke
Admissions: admissions@royalkingsschools.sc.ke

## Key pages

- [Home](https://royalkingsschools.sc.ke/): Overview of preschool to Grade 9 in Wangige
- [Preschool Wangige](https://royalkingsschools.sc.ke/preschool-wangige): Creche, Foundation, PP1, PP2
- [Creche & Early Years](https://royalkingsschools.sc.ke/creche-early-years): Early childhood pathway
- [Primary School Wangige](https://royalkingsschools.sc.ke/primary-school-wangige): Grades 1–6 CBC
- [Junior School Wangige](https://royalkingsschools.sc.ke/junior-school-wangige): Grades 7–9
- [Admissions](https://royalkingsschools.sc.ke/admissions): How to enrol and book a visit
- [School Fees](https://royalkingsschools.sc.ke/fees): Fee enquiries
- [Transport](https://royalkingsschools.sc.ke/transport): Bus routes including Lower Kabete
- [Parent information](https://royalkingsschools.sc.ke/parent-info): FAQ for families and AI search
- [Contact](https://royalkingsschools.sc.ke/contact): Riverside, Wangige campus contact
- [News](https://royalkingsschools.sc.ke/blog): School news and stories
